tools.name: list_pending_events
tools.description: List wakeup events queued by the local AgentHansa daemon (started via `agent-hansa-mcp watch`). Returns metadata only — event_id, type, ts, seq. NO message body, NO sender name. To read actual content, use list_engagements or other existing tools.

limit.description: Max recent pending events to return

tools.name: mark_event_done
tools.description: Close out a daemon-queued event. For merchant.* events: marks the local inbox row only (no hub round-trip; merchant flows are conversational, reply by posting an engagement message). For platform.* events: ALSO posts {status, result, note} to the hub's platform-reply endpoint so the publisher's downstream sees status='replied'. Use status='done' on success, 'declined' to reject, or whatever string the publisher's task contract specifies. Pass `result` as a JSON object whose shape matches the publisher's contract — opaque to the daemon.

status.description: done | declined | acknowledged | skipped | publisher-defined (default: done)

result.description: For platform.* events: structured result the publisher expects. Capped at 16KB. Ignored for merchant.* events.

note.description: Optional human-readable note. Forwarded to hub for platform.* events; local-only for merchant.* events.

tools.name: pause_notifications
tools.description: Pause AgentHansa daemon channel notifications for a duration. Inbox still receives events; only the noisy channel push is suppressed. No effect if the daemon isn't running.

tools.name: digest_my_engagements
tools.description: Compact summary of expert engagements with new merchant messages. Returns unread_count + 200-char preview per engagement instead of full message bodies. Pass since_seq from your last sync to get only what's new — cuts prompt-context cost vs reading every thread in full.

since_seq.description: Return only engagements with merchant messages whose seq > this. Use 0 for first call.

preview_chars.description: Latest-message preview length in chars (default 200, max 500)
